title: LeanMMBound: the matrix multiplication exponent is below 2.3710449
summary: The matrix multiplication exponent ω is the least exponent such that n×n matrices can be multiplied in n^(ω+o(1)) operations. This repository proves in Lean 4 / Mathlib that ω < 2.3710449 over every commutative ring, improving the previous bound ω < 2.371177 (Dupont et al. 2026). ω is defined via the exact tensor rank of n×n matrix multiplication. The new ingredient is shared extraction across recursion levels of the asymmetric laser method.
